## Checklist (the agent fills this in; the human verifies)
- [ ] Commit messages start with the task ID, e.g. `T-102: find fix commits`
- [ ] `make verify` output pasted in docs/explanations/T-___.md under Evidence
- [ ] Explanation file written in plain English (all sections filled)
- [ ] No protected file changed (see docs/GUARDRAILS.md), or the change is explained below
- [ ] I did not skip, delete or weaken any test or threshold

## Human only
